tooLarge: This AgSDL file is too large.

configurationNote: Inspect a configuration here. Selecting one updates runtime.selected explicitly.
noGraph: This document has no graph to display.
discardDescription: Reloading now will discard your unsaved changes.
selectElement: Select an element to inspect it.
title: Title

viewer.editScope: Instructions are shared with other calls to this agent.
viewer.editConflict: The document changed while you were editing. Cancel and reopen the editor to use the current version.
viewer.editSaveFailed: Changes are kept in the document as an unsaved draft. Retry saving or close to return to the graph.
viewer.chatHint: Ask in chat to create or update this workflow.
viewer.unresolvedAgent: Agent reference could not be resolved.
viewer.declarative: This document declares components without a workflow graph.
viewer.unknownTransfers: Input data and transfers are not specified.
viewer.migrationNote: The plan dependencies are preserved. Ask the agent to specify data transfers and transition conditions.
viewer.unreadable: This document cannot be displayed. Ask the agent to correct the AgSDL source.
viewer.noTransfer: No data transfer is declared on this connection.
viewer.exchangeHint: Select an agent to inspect its exchanges.
viewer.sharedProperties: Changes to shared definitions also affect other components that reference them.
viewer.unsupportedProperties: Linked contracts and unsupported properties are read-only. Return to the details view to attach this component to chat and coordinate changes to its consumers.
viewer.resourceRequired: An invocation needs at least one resource.
viewer.duplicateReference: Each reference must be unique in its list.

staleChatSelection: The document changed. Attach the selection again before sending.
queueRetained: Your message and its context are kept for retry: {{message}}
chatConversationMissing: Open this plan’s conversation before attaching AgSDL context.
queueRecorded: Your message and its context are saved in the conversation.

design.contextHint: Information shared across the system. The agent uses it to prepare the process.
design.rulesHint: Describe the requirements to translate into agent instructions and process checks. These notes do not enforce execution.
design.adaptationsHint: Define the information to provide when adapting this system. Values guide the design agent; they do not automatically reconfigure blocks.
design.snapshotHint: Save an independent copy of the current system, including its context and configuration. Existing adaptations remain unchanged.
design.startHint: Describe the process in the chat. The agent builds the system with you.
design.name: Name
design.included: Included in Macro · Adapt to your project
design.independentCopy: You will work on an independent copy. The original remains unchanged.
design.notEmpty: This system already contains a document. Create a new plan to use another starting point.
design.emptySystem: Describe the responsibilities and rules in the chat to build the first blocks. You can also prepare the shared context here.
design.otherChanged: Other parts of the document changed.
design.groupHint: Use the chat to group related responsibilities.
design.createSystemHelp: Start from scratch or use a blueprint.

designGraph.noExchanges: No exchanges declared between these components

macroConfig.title: Agent configuration
macroConfig.unsupported: This runtime configuration cannot be edited here. Ask the agent to prepare an unambiguous Macro binding.
macroConfig.scope: Only the declared tools and connections belong to this agent. Model selection does not grant additional access.
